title: Mother & Baby with Birthday Cake & Dog, 1952 Arkansas Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
CADDO PHOTO CO.
MAY 23 1952
Little Rock, Ark.
description: A charming outdoor snapshot capturing a young mother kneeling in a rural yard, holding her hooded toddler alongside a frosted birthday cake topped with a single candle. In front of them, a dark family dog waits patiently on the grass. Tall pine trees, a stone well, and a rustic outbuilding are visible in the background, embodying classic post-war mid-century American domestic life in Arkansas.
